metadata: document_id, source, page(unit), pep, title, pep_type, status, created_year, python_version, section(heading at chunk start), char_start/end
vectorizer: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (384d, local, normalized) + PostgreSQL16/pgvector 0.8.7 exact cosine (Chroma 1.5.9 HNSW gave identical top-3)
hypothesis: Small fixed windows give precise matches but cut sentences/sections and lose heading context
notes: 877 chunks; 117/877 span >1 section; all evidence fully contained in >=1 chunk

chunking: by_paragraph (heading starts new chunk; long paragraphs split at sentence)
hypothesis: Structure-aware chunks keep whole ideas + heading so Hit@1 and coherence improve; fewer chunks
notes: 532 chunks; only change vs A = chunking; t02 lost the exact NewType line at rank>3

filter: pep_type ($eq) only when the question carries a filter (5/20 questions); otherwise identical to B
hypothesis: Filtering by trustworthy pep_type removes off-scope chunks without hurting hits
notes: only change vs B = metadata filter; filter compliance 5/5 questions (B: 0/5 fully compliant)
